description: This file contains unit tests for the DeleteAttributes class in the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.things.modify package. It verifies immutability, equality/hashCode, creation with valid and invalid parameters, JSON serialization/deserialization, and contains related test constants.

classes.name: DeleteAttributesTest
classes.description: Unit test class for DeleteAttributes, testing immutability, equality, object creation, JSON serialization/deserialization, and invalid input handling.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that DeleteAttributes instances are immutable and that ThingId is also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies proper implementation of equals and hashCode methods in DeleteAttributes class using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingIdString
methods.description: Tests that creating a DeleteAttributes instance with a null String ThingId throws ThingIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingId
methods.description: Tests that creating a DeleteAttributes instance with null ThingId throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: createInstanceWithValidArguments
methods.description: Creates a DeleteAttributes instance with valid arguments and checks non-null and correct entityId.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the JSON output of DeleteAttributes matches the expected constant JSON.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Creates a DeleteAttributes instance from JSON string and verifies non-null and correct entityId.
